name: Paragraphs Sum Formatter
description: displays the sum of a configurable field across multi-valued paragraphs.
project_description:
Features 
 Paragraphs Sum formatter module provides a formatter that displays the sum of a configurable field on multi-valued paragraphs.

 Works with all core numeric fields, with the exception of phone. 

 Post-Installation 
 After installing this module a new formatter for paragraphs will be available 

 
 Go to the display settings of the content type. 
 Select the Paragraphs Sum formatter for the paragraph field. 
 Configure the formatter to use the numeric field you want to sum. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Paragraphs
